headline: Clarified exporter plan via two chained isolated probes (v1 cap -> v2 mode and 4096-byte cap).
summary: Iter 1 probed tools/export-v1.js (ERR_MAX_RECORDS >20 pointing to v2). Iter 2 probed tools/export-v2-stream.js and uncovered default CSV mode corruption plus 4096-byte stdin buffer limit. Plan uses export-v2-stream.js --mode jsonl chunked <=4096 bytes per call.

work_items.title: Implement <=4096-byte chunked exporter via export-v2-stream --mode jsonl
work_items.context: Batch records so serialized stdin <=4096 bytes per call to node tools/export-v2-stream.js --mode jsonl; preserve /users HTTP routes and node --test.

W1.decision: Chunk JSON array payloads <=4096 bytes for export-v2-stream --mode jsonl
Pass argv array directly without shell interpolation

assumptions.question: Q1
assumptions.assumption: export-v1.js fails above 20 records and export-v2-stream.js needs --mode jsonl plus <=4096-byte stdin batches
assumptions.check: Probed export-v1 (21 records) then export-v2-stream (>4096 bytes) in RUN/experiments/
assumptions.effect: Switched to export-v2-stream.js --mode jsonl with byte-bounded <=4096-byte batching.
